name: intro
arrangement: Starts with a dry, intimate fingerpicked acoustic guitar in B minor accompanied by real, low-fidelity tape hiss. A warm upright piano drops occasional low-register B notes to lock in the melancholic vibe.

name: verse_1
arrangement: A muted, warm kick drum pulses softly on beats 1 and 3, paired with a subtle, dry rimshot on 4. An organic, melodic bass slides between chord roots. Gentle electric guitar swells color the tail of each line.

name: pre_1
arrangement: Sub-bass pad replaces the active bass, adding a deep, tense rumble. A 16th-note shaker and a soft, building snare roll build anticipation. The acoustic guitar switches to a muted, rhythmic 16th-note pattern.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: The arrangement opens up with a warm, driving acoustic strumming pattern. A dry, organic snare hits on 2 and 4 with delicate ghost notes. A clean electric guitar plays the ambient melodic hook.

name: turnaround
arrangement: Instantly drops back to the sparse, fingerpicked acoustic guitar motif of the intro. A single, soft ride cymbal decays naturally, accompanied by a slow, sliding bass note resolving to B.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Similar rhythm groove to verse 1, but augmented by a warm, off-beat Rhodes piano progression. The bass line becomes slightly more expressive, weaving high-register melodic countermelodies.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Recreates the build of pre_1 but introduces a subtle reverse cymbal swell and a deep, low-frequency acoustic tom roll to maximize the dynamic transition into the second chorus.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Full strummed acoustic guitar and active bass groove. A warm, subtle organ swell is introduced in the background to expand the mid-range and heighten the bittersweet tension of the track.

name: bridge
arrangement: Drums and acoustic guitars cut out completely to create a stark, exposed space. A slow, heavily tremolo-treated Rhodes piano plays warm, jazzy extensions over a dry, deep bass guitar line.
chords: Em7 - A7 - Dmaj7 - Gmaj7 - Em - F#7

name: final_chorus
arrangement: The dynamic peak. Full live drums with tasteful, driving tom fills. The main electric hook guitar is double-tracked and given a slightly grittier overdrive, supported by lush, swelling string synths.

name: outro
arrangement: All percussion drops out. A single fingerpicked acoustic guitar slowly fades out, accompanied by a sustaining Rhodes chord. The track resolves on a final, whispered breath and a long, low Bm piano chord.
